# JVM Build Tools MCP Server 2.0.0-rc.2

This is a **breaking prerelease** for existing 1.x clients. Configure an allowed project root, refresh `tools/list`, and grant HTTP clients only the scopes they need. The public catalog has 24 tools and three native build-workflow prompts. This candidate negotiates MCP `2025-11-25`; selected official scenarios passed, but it does not claim full conformance.

Compared with rc.1, completed Maven, Gradle, and sbt build calls now carry authoritative process exit status and bounded, redacted diagnostics even when the useful error was in the middle of large output. Build analysis and execution expose the same safe JSON in MCP `structuredContent` and text, with an advertised `outputSchema`.

The always-zero `buildtools.cache.hit.rate` gauge was removed. Update dashboards that query `buildtools_cache_hit_rate`; `buildtools.cache.score` remains a cache-health score, not a comparable hit-rate metric.

Maven configuration validation and dependency scans now use bounded, race-resistant reads where the runtime supports secure directory handles. OSV and Maven Central lookups have fixed destinations, input validation, response limits, deadlines, and incomplete/unknown states instead of false-clean results. `check_dependency_version(includeSecurityInfo=true)` sends the supplied coordinates and version to OSV.dev and returns only aggregate status, vulnerability count, and known or unknown severity through MCP. Complete CVSS v3.1 base vectors are scored for single-coordinate lookups; unsupported vectors and sparse batch matches remain unknown. Keep the OSV option off when dependency-inventory egress is unacceptable.

Build scripts and plugins still run with the server process's operating-system permissions and can read credentials or use the network. For untrusted projects, use a credential-free container or equivalent OS isolation. On filesystems without Java `SecureDirectoryStream`, some project operations fail closed and others retain a documented path-swap risk; see the [security guide](https://github.com/thepragmatik/mcp-server-jvm-build-tools/blob/v2.0.0-rc.2/SECURITY.md).

Start with the [2.0 quickstart](https://github.com/thepragmatik/mcp-server-jvm-build-tools/blob/v2.0.0-rc.2/docs/user-guide/quickstart-v2.md), then read the [migration guide](https://github.com/thepragmatik/mcp-server-jvm-build-tools/blob/v2.0.0-rc.2/docs/user-guide/migration-v2.md) and [release gates](https://github.com/thepragmatik/mcp-server-jvm-build-tools/blob/v2.0.0-rc.2/docs/reference/release-gates.md).
